name: Atexxo Zone 2 iPad Pro 11-inch
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 iPad Pro 11-inch is a standard iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, rated for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an Ex ec ic-rated design, and the tablet runs iPadOS 27.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 iPad Pro 11-inch, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates for 7–8 years (based on previous iPad Pro support)

specs.display: 11-inch Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED, ProMotion 10-120 Hz, P3, True Tone, antireflective coating; nano-texture glass option on 1 and 2 TB
specs.camera: 12 MP Wide, f/1.8, True Tone flash
specs.frontCamera: 12 MP Center Stage, landscape, TrueDepth (Face ID)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.ports: Thunderbolt / USB 4 (USB-C, up to 40 Gb/s); Smart Connector; magnetic Apple Pencil connector
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.network: Wi-Fi only or Wi-Fi + Cellular (5G sub-6 GHz)
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button (no Touch ID; Face ID model), volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C); magnetic attach and charge, hover
specs.keyboard: Smart Connector (Magic Keyboard for iPad Pro)
specs.partNumbers: EX-TABLET-PR-11-256, -256-CEL, -512, -512-CEL, -1Tb, -1Tb-CEL, -2Tb, -2Tb-CEL; EX-TABLET-PR-11-* (DEP/ABM conversion, new tablets only)

strengths: Security updates for 7–8 years (based on previous iPad Pro support)
A standard iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) inside, with the same apps and Apple device management
Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 1040 g in use
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
Ex marking not yet confirmed against a published certificate
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
